details.description: Existing production Admin Panel source and image attestation before the diagnostic logs menu change

change_summary.expected_result: The Admin Panel exposes a protected diagnostic logs page at /logs without changing LibreChat chat, API, MongoDB, Office, CodeAPI, or Nginx behavior.
functions: Add a Diagnostic logs item to the Admin Panel sidebar and command menu
Add a permission-gated /logs route with filters, summary fields, and a result table shell
Document the diagnostic event API, privacy boundary, retention, and indexes
limitations: The diagnostic event API is not part of this release, so the page explicitly shows an unavailable state and no fabricated rows
The page temporarily reuses read:audit_log until a dedicated read:diagnostic_logs capability is implemented
change_summary.reason: Provide an administrator-facing entry point for the planned runtime diagnostic logs and a stable UI contract for the backend event endpoint.
change_summary.risk: Low: only the standalone Admin Panel image changes; the release runner recreates LibreChat-Admin-Panel only and retains a compose backup for rollback.

details.method: Restore the backed-up compose override and recreate only the Admin Panel image/container.

validation_plan.expected: Pinned source, localization, source-tree hash, and secret scan pass.
Localization, format, import, lint, typecheck, tests, build, amd64 image, and final admin-ci tag pass.
Only LibreChat-Admin-Panel is recreated; API, Nginx, CodeAPI, RAG, and MongoDB remain unchanged.
Diagnostic logs menu and page render, permission boundary remains enforced, and unavailable API state is explicit.
